# unbound_local_zone (Resource)

Configured local-zone ressource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unbound_local_zone" "example_eu" {
  name = "example.eu."
  type = "transparent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the zone
- `type` (String) Type of the zone

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the zone
- `last_updated` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNS zones can be imported by specifying the ID (# at the end of the config line)
terraform import unbound_local_zone.example_eu "2"
```
